Package com.bupt.ta.model

Class MoWorkloadSnapshot

java.lang.Object
com.bupt.ta.model.MoWorkloadSnapshot
public class MoWorkloadSnapshot extends Object
Per-application workload context assembled for module-owner (MO) approval and AI advice.

Built at request time by WorkloadService; not persisted. Summarizes how approving one pending application would affect the applicant's total load relative to TaWorkloadStats.ASSIGNED_JOBS_WARNING_THRESHOLD.

Not thread-safe: list fields are mutable ArrayList instances populated during snapshot construction; intended for single-threaded servlet request handling.
